snippet.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl | Launch Trailer [GOG]
snippet.description:
The Zone calls to those brave enough to answer. Face mutants, deadly anomalies, and cunning rivals in a world where every decision shapes your destiny. Uncover the Zone's darkest secrets… if you can survive and endure its trials.
